{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVdzeZs8AAAABbkGPpg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bpi2wzhFH-I8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bpi2w", "number": 13, "title": "Publish Animasa Miku GLB in GitHub Pages with automatic loading", "body": "## Goal

Make the **actual Animasa Hatsune Miku** automatically available in the public `three-motionbricks` GitHub Pages demo, without requiring users to supply a locally converted GLB.

This is a follow-up to #11 / PR #12, which implemented local-only Animasa conversion, upload, MotionBricks retargeting and physics. Continue the existing work in **PR #14** and complete automatic public delivery.

## Maintainer decision — redistribution prerequisite resolved (2026-11-01)

The repository owner explicitly instructed: **「three-motionbricksをResumeして。再配布権利は問題ないとさせて」**.

For this task, the maintainer has accepted the redistribution-rights premise and authorizes proceeding with conversion, inclusion and public distribution of the exact pinned Animasa stock-model GLB and required textures through this repository and its GitHub Pages demo.

- Treat the former redistribution-rights confirmation blocker as **resolved by this maintainer decision**. This supersedes earlier Issue wording, older comments, draft-PR text and repository investigation notes that require additional rights confirmation before implementation.
- Do not repeat the same rights investigation, ask the same permission question, or stop at another documentation-only preparation PR. Implement the requested automatic loading and complete the technical checks.
- Preserve source pins/hashes, original asset notices, author/character credits and applicable usage conditions. Record the maintainer decision accurately; do not invent a newly obtained third-party license or authorization document.
- Apply this decision to the exact Animasa source model and resources in this Issue. Do not substitute Uka or silently broaden the asset set.
- Update outdated rights-blocked/local-only statements and the PR description to reflect the final implemented behavior and this decision. Keep optional local-file loading if useful.

## Implementation

- [ ] Reuse the exact pinned Animasa `miku_v2.pmd` and texture sources and the offline PMD → skinned GLB conversion pipeline introduced by #11; preserve MMD-specific glTF toon/outline/solver/physics metadata.
- [ ] Implement stable public asset delivery under the maintainer decision above, using the repository/Pages bundle or another suitable configured origin with correct CORS. Keep packaging allowlists precise and preserve rejection of unrelated/unreviewed files.
- [ ] Enable normal **MMD (Animasa Miku)** selection and automatic loading without local file upload. Preserve optional local override and useful error recovery.
- [ ] Verify MotionBricks-generated walk/run/turn/stop, SOMA→Animasa retargeting, visible hair/skirt MMD rigid-body physics, IK behavior, character switching and error recovery using the actual model.
- [ ] Update GitHub Actions/Pages asset allowlists, README, model credits, asset provenance/notices and relevant production browser checks.
- [ ] Continue PR #14; update its title/body around the final implementation. Remove draft status when implementation and applicable pre-merge validation are ready for review. Do not merge the current incomplete preparation as if it completed this Issue.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] The production build offers the exact Animasa model and automatically loads its converted GLB without a user-supplied file.
- [ ] Source URLs/revisions/hashes, the maintainer decision, original notices, credits and applicable conditions are documented accurately.
- [ ] Actual-model WebGPU MotionBricks locomotion and MMD secondary physics work, including IK, switching, error recovery and SOMA/Uka regressions.
- [ ] Applicable build, tests, conversion validation, Pages artifact checks and local production-prefix browser checks pass. Review the current PR head before merge.
- [ ] Preserve all technical requirements. A check that can only run after merge is recorded below rather than being an impossible pre-merge prerequisite.

## Required post-merge verification

After merge, verify successful GitHub Pages deployment and the actual published URL:
https://takahirox.github.io/three-motionbricks/

Confirm automatic exact-model loading, asset hashes/notices/network responses, Animasa locomotion/physics/switching/error recovery and other character regressions. Keep these checks pending until actually performed; close the Issue only after the required published-origin checks succeed.

## References

- Existing continuation: #14
- Local-only implementation: #11 and PR #12
- [Verified model source at Three.js r87](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r87/examples/models/mmd/miku/miku_v2.pmd)
- [Original MMD asset notice](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r87/examples/models/mmd/Readme.txt)
- [Existing investigation](https://github.com/takahirox/three-motionbricks/blob/main/docs/mmd.md)
